Examples of fine-mapping with SuSiE-RSS, SuSiE-AIW, and SuSiE-IW when the
reference LD differs from the study LD.

1. [Getting started with susieRobust](01-get-started.html): load simulated LD,
   simulate association statistics, fit the methods, and compare their posterior
   inclusion probabilities.
2. [A closer look at IW](02-closer-look-at-IW.html): fit IW to the same example,
   then refit with eta0 fixed at twice its learned value.

The tutorials use saved LD matrices, so Python and stdpopsim are optional.
The [source code and example data](https://github.com/dodat-stats/susieRobust-workflowr)
are available on GitHub.
